messages:
Maya: Heads-up — we're seeing a docs PR surge tied to the 0.9 release. ~12 small PRs (snippets, link fixes, migration notes). Need reviewer coverage and a merge order. CI/docs-preview is a bit flaky right now.
Sam: Ack. Which ones are highest priority?
Maya: Priorities: 1) migration-guide update (large) 2) SDK snippet corrections (several small PRs) 3) link relocations + redirects 4) cherry-picks/backports for main.
Priya: I can pick up the migration-guide. Can someone pair on the auth code example that changed the flow?
Jordan: I can pair on the auth snippet. @Priya assign to me and I'll run a local preview + quick readthrough.
Maya: Assigned: Priya -> migration-guide, Jordan -> auth snippet. We still need a second reviewer for the migration-guide before we merge. Who's on docs rotation today? @Olivia?
Olivia: I'm on rotation but heads-down on a customer ticket. I can do second-pass reviews, but prefer to merge only after CI green. ETA ~2h for a final review.
DocsBot: CI preview failure on PR #8123 — remark-lint error in migration-guide. Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/8123
Sam: I'll take the lint fix and push a patch. Also can take one SDK snippet PR (#8130) after that.
Priya: Thanks Sam. Please add a tiny test snippet so the preview renderer shows the new layout.
Sam: Will add test snippet. Merge order proposal: lint fix -> migration-guide -> SDK snippets -> link fixes. Avoid merging link moves until redirects verified.
Jordan: Agree. Reminder: branch freeze at 18:00 UTC. Anything not merged by then needs an explicit backport plan.
Olivia: If CI is flaky we can run the staging docs-preview manually. Command I use: `./tools/docs-preview --pr 8123 --staging`.
Maya: Good idea. Jordan, can you run that once Sam pushes the lint fix?
Jordan: Yep, will run manual preview and report issues.
Sam: Pushed lint fix and tiny test snippet. CI queued.
DocsBot: CI status: PR #8123 — docs-preview passed on staging; remark-lint fixed.
Jordan: Manual preview ran. Migration-guide looks good on desktop but table spacing breaks on mobile — left an inline comment with repro steps.
Priya: I'll patch the spacing and add a short note about cache invalidation for the redirect entries.
Olivia: After Priya's patch, I can do final approval. Note we need two approvals for the migration-guide per policy.
Maya: Does anyone object to Sam merging the SDK snippet PRs after Olivia approves the migration-guide? We'd like them in before freeze.
Jordan: No objections from me.
Sam: I have #8130 and #8135 ready; will rebase once migration-guide merges.
Olivia: Quick procedural note — please add labels `docs/ready` and `release/0.9` to PRs so the release tooling picks them up.
Maya: Added that to our checklist. Final plan: Priya patches -> Jordan reruns manual preview -> Olivia approves -> Sam merges snippets -> Maya updates release notes and triggers backports if needed. Ping here when merged.
Priya: Patch pushed to #8123 (spacing + cache note).
DocsBot: PR #8123 updated — auto re-run CI.
DocsBot: PR #8123 status: All checks passed.
Jordan: Reran manual preview, looks clean now. Approving.
Olivia: Approving as well. :rocket:
Sam: Merged #8130 and #8135, added short changelog lines.
Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release notes and schedule backports for anything that misses the freeze.
Olivia: One more thing — let's create a tiny runbook for the next surge: pairing contacts, who handles lint fast fixes, and a short checklist for manual preview. Saves time next time.
Maya: Agreed, adding runbook item to the docs backlog.
